_comment: TEMPLATE / schema illustration. reproduce_claims.py reads historical-evidence.json (this shape) to DERIVE external_claims_complete: complete iff doi + archive_sha256 + top_level_manifest_sha256 are set and claim_map covers C1d-C1g. The submission's finalize_deposit.py writes the real file itself (it computes archive_sha256 and top_level_manifest_sha256 from the actual deposit and checks them against deposit/CHECKSUMS.txt), so you normally do not edit this by hand. top_level_manifest_sha256 = sha256 of the deposit's top-level SHA256SUMS (the manifest-of-manifests). doi empty -> external stays incomplete (the correct pre-deposit state).
